environment: local installed Supabase SDK, synthetic sessions and network transport
rootCause: The SDK resolves the current JWT after an awaited consent lookup; original input was not pinned to its originating session and pending transport was not cancelled on owner changes.
reproduction: Pause consent response for A, replace the current local session with B, release the response. The installed SDK sent A's synthetic request body with B's synthetic Authorization header.
repair: Require originating bound account, verify session matches it, filter the receipt by account, pin the Edge Authorization header, propagate AbortSignal and cancel on owner changes/unmount. No owner or consent authority is sent in the request body.
residualRisk: Client cancellation cannot recall content already transmitted before the switch. Requests retain the originating JWT and late completions are discarded. Live authenticated synthetic certification is outstanding.
